text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hello, my name is Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I wish to become a gust of wind sweeping through the races, blowing gently like a cool breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I kindly ask for your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
